{{Quote|I know, Cinda&mdash;I feel the same way. But Berl joined the Rebellion to bring freedom to the galaxy. And I think he'd be happy knowing that he died on a mission that succeeded, in its own small way, in doing just that.''"<br />"''I guess you're right, Commander. And I suppose, at least until this bloody war is over&mdash;that's all ''any'' of us can ask.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Cinda Tarheel/Legends|Cinda Tarheel]]|<ref name="Marvel 64" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], three members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were dispatched on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. Their goal was to establish good relations with the native [[Serp]]s, but chaos ensued, and [[Berl (Alliance)|one Rebel pilot]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. All was well again after [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Doom-Joust/Legends|jousted]] with the [[S'Shah|king]].
